title: No backup candidate is both outside the J-space and used; the column count stays the only clean one
caption: Nine backup non-J candidates at layer 42. A: enrichment of the class-mean direction in the top-384 J-space (dark = at or below 1.5), with each feature's shuffled-label reference (tick). B: effect on the predicted next-token behaviour of steering at layer 38 along the direction with the top-1536 J-space removed, as a multiple of the largest |effect| of 24 random J-complement directions, signed, at the q90 (open) and q99 (filled) doses (error bar: 95% item-bootstrap CI of the effect divided by that random maximum). Only indentation and sentence position are depleted; indentation does not move, sentence position is J-lens readable. Caveat: point estimates in A carry no CI.
